title: NASA's SDO Captures Stunning 4K View of April 17 Solar Flare
contents: Solar Dynamics Observatory extreme-ultraviolet views of the Sun (gold, teal, magenta wavelengths) zooming into an active region that erupts in an M6.7 flare (bright flash). Skips the opening caption and the closing NASA Heliophysics/Goddard logo cards. AUDIO REMOVED (silent AAC track): the soundtrack is uncredited production music, removed to be safe.
